**Just as bulls yoked together and tied to a central post to thresh rice tread around that pivot without deviating from their proper positions—one bull being closest to the post, another in the middle, and a third on the outside--so all the planets and luminaries, fixed in the zodiac, revolve around the polestar in their respective orbits, some higher and some lower, till the end of the** ***kalpa,*** **propelled by wind. Just as clouds or eagles, controlled by the wind, pushed by** ***karma*****, move about in the sky, so the planets, supported by matter and the Lord, and moving by their past** ***karmas*****, do not fall to the ground**

**Комментарий:**

As bulls are made to walk around a post at different positions during three times of the day, morning, noon and afternoon (*tribhiḥ savanaiḥ*) by the farmer, so the planets move around the pole star. Controlled by māyā situated in the Lord (*prakṛti-puruṣa-samñogānugṛhītaḥ*), the planets do not fall.

### Text 4

*kecanaitaj jyotir-anīkaṁ śiśumāra-saṁsthānena bhagavato vāsudevasya yoga-dhāraṇāyām anuvarṇayanti.*

**Перевод:**

**Some describe this zodiac belt to be the form of a dolphin, used for worshipping Vāsudeva in meditation.**

**Комментарий:**

The zodiac conceived as a dolphin, like the universal form, is a means of becoming absorbed in worship. This becomes clear with statements in verse 7 and 8.

### Text 5

*yasya pucchāgre 'vākśirasaḥ kuṇḍalī-bhūta-dehasya dhruva upakalpitas tasya lāṅgūle prajāpatir agnir indro dharma iti puccha-mūle dhātā vidhātā ca kaṭyāṁ saptarṣayaḥ; tasya dakṣiṇāvarta-kuṇḍalī-bhūta-śarīrasya yāny udagayanāni dakṣiṇa-pārśve tu nakṣatrāṇy upakalpayanti dakṣiṇāyanāni tu savye; yathā śiśumārasya kuṇḍalā-bhoga-sanniveśasya pārśvayor ubhayor apy avayavāḥ samasaṅkhyā bhavanti; pṛṣṭhe tv ajavīthī ākāśa-gaṅgā codarataḥ.*

**Перевод:**

**This form of the dolphin has its head downward and its body coiled. On the end of its tail is the planet of Dhruva, on the body of its tail are the planets of the** ***devatās*** **Prajāpati, Agni, Indra and Dharma, and at the base of its tail are the planets of the** ***devatās*** **Dhātā and Vidhātā. On the hips are the seven saintly sages like Vasiṣṭha and Aṅgirā. The coiled body of the dolphin turns toward the right side, on which the fourteen constellations from Abhijit to Punarvasu are located. On its left side are the fourteen stars from Puṣyā to Uttarāṣāḍhā. Thus its body is balanced because its sides are occupied by an equal number of stars on each side. On the back of the dolphin is the group of stars known as Ajavīthī, and on its abdomen is the Gaṅgā that flows in the sky (the Milky Way).**

**Комментарий:**

The dolphin coils around (*kuṇḍalībhūta*). *Udagayanānī* means “they should be conceived.” The right side is described, not the back or front side. The listing of constellations appears to go in reverse because the form twists sideways, up and down. Nārāyaṇa and various planets are situated on its heart and other places. Ajavīthī is the first section on the southern path. It consists of Mūla, Pūrvāṣāḍha and Uttarāṣāḍha. When the constellations are said to be situated on the ears etc. these are to be considered to be various parts of the torso. The Milky Way is also on the torso.

### Text 7

*uttarā-hanāv agastir adharā-hanau yamo mukheṣu cāṅgārakaḥ śanaiścara upasthe bṛhaspatiḥ kakudi vakṣasy ādityo hṛdaye nārāyaṇo manasi candro nābhyām uśanā stanayor aśvinau budhaḥ prāṇāpānayo rāhur gale ketavaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu romasu sarve tārā-gaṇāḥ.*

**Перевод:**

**On the upper chin of the dolphin is Agasti; on its lower chin, Yamarāja; on its mouth, Mars; on its genitals, Saturn; on the back of its neck, Jupiter; on its chest, the sun; and within the core of its heart, Nārāyaṇa. Within its mind is the moon; on its navel, Venus; and on its breasts, the Aśvinī-kumāras. Its life air composed of** ***prāṇa*** **and** ***āpāna*** **is Mercury. On its neck is Rāhu. All over its body are comets, and in its pores are the numerous stars.**

**Комментарий:**

Though the planets like Mars move through the different zodiac signs, they are said to be situated on various limbs, while thinking that the various limbs move about.

## Chapter Twenty-four

### Text 1

*śrī-śuka uvāca*  
*adhastāt savitur yojanāyute svarbhānur nakṣatravac caratīty eke yo 'sāv amaratvaṁ grahatvaṁ cālabhata bhagavad-anukampayā svayam asurāpasadaḥ saiṁhikeyo hy atad-arhas tasya tāta janma karmāṇi copariṣṭād vakṣyāmaḥ.*

**Перевод:**

**Śukadeva Gosvāmī said: The speakers of the Purāṇas say that 10,000** ***yojanas*** **below the sun is the planet known as Rāhu, which moves like one of the constellations. The presiding deity of that planet, who is the son of Siṁhikā, the most abominable of all** ***asuras,*** **has attained the position of a** ***devatā*** **by the mercy of the Lord, though he is not qualified to be a** ***devatā*****. O King! Later I shall speak about him.**

**Комментарий:**

Actually Rāhu does not move like the constellations, since it is beyond the wind which moves them. It moves on its own.

### Text 2

*yad adas taraṇer maṇḍalaṁ pratapatas tad vistarato yojanāyutam ācakṣate dvādaśa-sahasraṁ somasya trayodaśa-sahasraṁ rāhor yaḥ parvaṇi tad-vyavadhāna-kṛd vairānubandhaḥ sūryā-candramasāv abhidhāvati.*

**Перевод:**

**They say that the sun globe measures 10,000** ***yojanas*** **in diameter and the moon measure** ***20,000*** **yojanas in diameter, whereas Rāhu is 30,000** ***yojanas*** **in diameter. Obstructing the sun and moon previously, he has become their enemy, and attacks them on the full and dark moon days.**

**Комментарий:**

The sun glove (*taraṇer maṇḍalam*) is the circle of light situated within seat of the chariot.

### Text 8

*eteṣu hi bila-svargeṣu svargād apy adhika-kāma-bhogaiśvaryānanda-bhūti-vibhūtibhiḥ susamṛddha-bhavanodyānākrīḍa-vihāreṣu daitya-dānava-kādraveyā nitya-pramuditānurakta-kalatrāpatya-bandhu-suhṛd-anucarā gṛha-pataya īśvarād apy apratihata-kāmā māyā-vinodā nivasanti.*

**Перевод:**

**The Daityas, Dānavas and Nāgas, who are householders always enamored by their wives, children, friends and society in beautiful houses, gardens and play grounds, and having greater wealth, power, bliss and sense enjoyment than the higher planets, live there in illusory enjoyment, with desires more unimpeded than in Svarga.**

**Комментарий:**

*Īśvarāt means* “with capability.”

### Text 19

*no evaitat sākṣātkāro bhūmi-dānasya yat tad bhagavaty aśeṣa-jīva-nikāyānāṁ jīva-bhūtātma-bhūte paramātmani vāsudeve tīrthatame pātra upapanne parayā śraddhayā paramādara-samāhita-manasā sampratipāditasya sākṣād apavarga-dvārasya yad bila-nilayaiśvaryam.*

**Перевод:**

**Mere attainment of the enjoyment on Sutala is not the real result of Bali’s giving land to Vāsudeva, the life of unlimited** ***jīvas*****, the supreme source of Paramātmā, the most suitable and most pure. This act was executed with great faith and devotion and is the door to the highest liberation.**

**Комментарий:**

Mere attainment of the enjoyment on Sutala is not the only result (*no evaitad*) of Bali’s giving land to Vāsudeva

### Text 21

*tad bhaktānām ātmavatāṁ sarveṣām ātmany ātmada ātmatayaiva.*

**Перевод:**

**Enjoying Svarga was not the result of giving land to the Supreme Lord, who gives himself to his devotees and gives realization of Paramātmā to the** ***ātmārāmas.***

**Комментарий:**

Bali’s giving was not the cause of any result. The Lord appears as Paramātmā to all jñānīs, but to the devotees he gives himself, and appears before them, being under their control. His nature is to be the supreme helper to all people. Thus he cannot give insignificant results.

### Text 22

*na vai bhagavān nūnam amuṣyānujagrāha yad uta punar ātmānusmṛti-moṣaṇaṁ māyāmaya-bhogaiśvaryam evātanuteti.*

**Перевод:**

**The Lord did not show mercy to Indra, because his bestowal of enjoyment and wealth, forms of** ***māyā,*** **destroy remembrance of the Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

He destroys the idea that giving material objects is mercy. Since his giving enjoyment and power full of māyā destroys remembrance of the Lord, he did not show such mercy to Bali. Rather he gave closeness to the Lord as a benediction. The reason is that such enjoyment and power destroys remembrance of the Lord. Or he destroys the idea of giving mercy to Indra. He did not show mercy to Indra, because giving material benedictions destroyed his remembrance of the Lord.

### Text 23

*yat tad bhagavatānadhigatānyopāyena yācñā-cchalenāpahṛta-sva-śarīrāvaśeṣita-loka-trayo varuṇa-pāśaiś ca sampratimukto giri-daryāṁ cāpaviddha iti hovāca.*

**Перевод:**

**Because the Lord, finding no other means, used the trick of begging to take away the three worlds from Bali, leaving only his body as his possession, bound him with Varuṇa’s ropes, and locked him in a mountain cave, Bali spoke as follows.**

**Комментарий:**

Bali’s words in five verses in prose act as proof. *Yat tat* means “it is well known.”

*Iti* indicates “Bali said this.”

### Text 24

*nūnaṁ batāyaṁ bhagavān artheṣu na niṣṇāto yo 'sāv indro yasya sacivo mantrāya vṛta ekāntato bṛhaspatis tam atihāya svayam upendreṇātmānam ayācatātmanaś cāśiṣo no eva tad-dāsyam ati-gambhīra-vayasaḥ kālasya manvantara-parivṛttaṁ kiyal loka-trayam idam.*

**Перевод:**

**Indeed, Indra, who employed Bṛhaspati as his exclusive assistant and minister, is not experienced in affairs. Neglecting the Lord, he instead asked me for the three worlds, material happiness, using the Lord, and not service to the Lord. What value are the three worlds, which change every Manvantara by the great speed of time?**

**Комментарий:**

Indra neglected Upendra (*tam*), not desiring the highest goal. He asked me, the lowest person, through the Lord, for the three worlds.

### Text 25

*yasyānudāsyam evāsmat-pitāmahaḥ kila vavre na tu sva-pitryaṁ yad utākutobhayaṁ padaṁ dīyamānaṁ bhagavataḥ param iti bhagavatoparate khalu sva-pitari.*

**Перевод:**

**Our grandfather accepted only service to the Lord, and not the property of his father, which the Lord offered him when he killed his father. He did not even accept the spiritual world, the place of no fear.**

**Комментарий:**

Our grandfather accepted to be the servant of the servant (*anudāsyam*).

*tasmād amūs tanu-bhṛtām aham āśiṣo 'jña*  
*āyuḥ śriyaṁ vibhavam aindriyam āviriñcyāt*  
*necchāmi te vilulitān uruvikrameṇa*  
*kālātmanopanaya māṁ nija-bhṛtya-pārśvam*

**I do not want these objects of enjoyments, life span, wealth, power, or sense enjoyment of living beings up to that of Brahmā, which are all destroyed by your power as time. Take me to the side of your servant. (SB 7.9.24)**

*Sva-pitryam* means ruling the three worlds. He did not even accept liberation (*yad utākutobhayaṁ padam*). Why? He thought it to be something other than the Lord (*bhagavataḥ param*), since it was only a portion of the Lord. This happened when the Lord killed his father.

### Text 26

*tasya mahānubhāvasyānupatham amṛjita-kaṣāyaḥ ko vāsmad-vidhaḥ parihīṇa-bhagavad-anugraha upajigamiṣatīti.*

**Перевод:**

**What materially contaminated person like me, devoid of the Lord’s mercy, desires to follow a path similar to that of the great devotee Prahlāda?**

**Комментарий:**

What person who does not appreciate the Lord’s mercy at all (*parihīṇa-bhagavad-anugrahaḥ*) desires to follow the path Prahlāda? The mercy took place after he was bound up and prayed.

### Text 28

*tato 'dhastāt talātale mayo nāma dānavendras tri-purādhipatir bhagavatā purāriṇā tri-lokī-śaṁ cikīrṣuṇā nirdagdha-sva-pura-trayas tat-prasādāl labdha-pado māyāvinām ācāryo mahādevena parirakṣito vigata-sudarśana-bhayo mahīyate.*

**Перевод:**

**Below Sutala, in Talātala resides Maya, king of the Dānavas, lord of three cities. His three cities were burned by Śiva, who desired the good of the three worlds. By Śiva’s grace Maya, master of the magicians, regained his position. Protected by Śiva, without fear of Sudarśana, he is worshipped.**

**Комментарий:**

Maya or Māyāvi remains in Talātala with material happiness by the shadow of mercy of Śiva. He did not attain spiritual happiness like Bali. That is shown here. Śiva is a great devotee of the Lord. By his request, Śiva acts in this way.

### Text 31

*tato 'dhastāt pātāle nāga-loka-patayo vāsuki-pramukhāḥ śaṅkha-kulika-mahāśaṅkha-śveta-dhanañjaya-dhṛtarāṣṭra-śaṅkhacūḍa-kambalāśvatara-devadattādayo mahā-bhogino mahāmarṣā nivasanti yeṣām u ha vai pañca-sapta-daśa-śata-sahasra-śīrṣāṇāṁ phaṇāsu viracitā mahā-maṇayo rociṣṇavaḥ pātāla-vivara-timira-nikaraṁ sva-rociṣā vidhamanti.*

**Перевод:**

**Below Rasātala, in Pātāla, reside the leaders of Nāga-loka, such as Śaṅkha, Kulika, Mahāśaṅkha, Śveta, Dhanañjaya, Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Śaṅkhacūḍa, Kambala, Aśvatara and Devadatta, headed by Vāsuki. They have many hoods and are very envious. The shining jewels fixed on five, seven, ten, a hundred or a thousand hoods, light up the darkness of the caves of Pātāla with their effulgence.**

**Комментарий:**

*Śīrṣāṇām* comes from *śīrṣan* found in Vedic language, according to *śīrṣaṁś chandasi* (Pāṇini 6.1.60).

## Chapter Twenty-five

### Text 1

*śrī-śuka uvāca*  
*tasya mūla-deśe triṁśad-yojana-sahasrāntara āste yā vai kalā bhagavatas tāmasī samākhyātānanta iti sātvatīyā draṣṭṛ-dṛśyayoḥ saṅkarṣaṇam aham ity abhimāna-lakṣaṇaṁ yaṁ saṅkarṣaṇam ity ācakṣate.*

**Перевод:**

**Śukadeva Gosvāmī said: 30,000** ***yojanas*** **the planet Pātāla lives Ananta, an expansion of the Supreme Lord, called** ***tamasī*****. The devotees call him Saṅkarṣaṇa because he draws together (*****saṅkaṛṣaṇa*****) the enjoyer and the object to be enjoyed, characterized by the conception of “I.”**

**Комментарий:**

He is called Tāmasī because he is the antaryāmī of Śiva, the deity of tamo-guṇa. He is not in tamoguṇa, since this would a contradiction to SB 5.25.10.

### Text 3

*yasya ha vā idaṁ kālenopasañjihīrṣato 'marṣa-viracita-rucira-bhramad-bhruvor antareṇa sāṅkarṣaṇo nāma rudra ekādaśa-vyūhas try-akṣas tri-śikhaṁ śūlam uttambhayann udatiṣṭhat.*

**Перевод:**

**When Ananta desires to destroy the entire creation, from between his two moving eyebrows appears three-eyed Rudra, composed of anger, with eleven expansions, carrying a raised trident.**

**Комментарий:**

He displays anger because most of the living entities are opposed to the Lord.

### Text 10

*mūrtiṁ naḥ puru-kṛpayā babhāra sattvaṁ*  
*saṁśuddhaṁ sad-asad idaṁ vibhāti tatra*  
*yal-līlāṁ mṛga-patir ādade 'navadyām*  
*ādātuṁ svajana-manāṁsy udāra-vīryaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**By his great mercy the Lord has shown his form of pure** ***sattva*****, within which the universe of cause and effect exists and by which, in the form of Varāha, performing numerous heroic deeds, he enacted spotless pastimes to attract the minds of his devotees.**

**Комментарий:**

*Mṛgapati* refers to Varāhā.

*dadarśa tatrābhijitaṁ dharā-dharaṁ*  
*pronnīyamānāvanim agra-daṁṣṭrayā*  
*muṣṇantam akṣṇā sva-ruco ’ruṇa-śriyā*  
*jahāsa cāho vana-gocaro mṛgaḥ*

**He saw the Lord, holder of the earth, lifting high the earth on the tips of his tusks, diminishing Hiraṇyākṣa’s splendor with his reddish eyes. Hiraṇyākṣa laughed, “O! You are a beast that lives in the water!” (SB 3.18.2)**

Accepting the form of an animal to hold up the earth is a glorification of the Lord.

### Text 12

*mūrdhany arpitam aṇuvat sahasra-mūrdhno*  
*bhū-golaṁ sagiri-sarit-samudra-sattvam*  
*ānantyād animita-vikramasya bhūmnaḥ*  
*ko vīryāṇy adhi gaṇayet sahasra-jihvaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Since the Lord is unlimited, what person, even having a thousand tongues, can count the powers of the great Lord of immeasurable powers, Ananta with a thousand heads, who has placed on just one of his heads the small particle known as the universe with its mountains, rivers oceans and living beings?**

**Комментарий:**

Though the form of the Lord is only of medium size, because of his powers, Bhū-maṇḍala becomes very small.

## Chapter Twenty-six

### Text 2

*ṛṣir uvāca*  
*tri-guṇatvāt kartuḥ śraddhayā karma-gatayaḥ pṛthag-vidhāḥ sarvā eva sarvasya tāratamyena bhavanti.*

**Перевод:**

**Śukadeva said: Because of the faith of the doer arising from the three** ***guṇas,*** **different varieties of destinations for action appear. All these destinations appear for all people in proportion to the** ***guṇas.***

**Комментарий:**

“One will get various results in various planets because the Lord is not equal to all beings.” The Lord is equal. That is explained.

### Text 3

*athedānīṁ pratiṣiddha-lakṣaṇasyādharmasya tathaiva kartuḥ śraddhāyā vaisādṛśyāt karma-phalaṁ visadṛśaṁ bhavati yā hy anādy-avidyayā kṛta-kāmānāṁ tat-pariṇāma-lakṣaṇāḥ sṛtayaḥ sahasraśaḥ pravṛttās tāsāṁ prācuryeṇānuvarṇayiṣyāmaḥ.*

**Перевод:**

**For the performer of forbidden acts of** ***adharma*****, as with the performer of** ***dharma*****, there are varieties of results for actions according to differences in faith of the performer. The destinations for performing acts out of desire caused by beginningless ignorance are merely transformations of those desires, with thousands of varieties. Among these destinations I shall describe in the detail the various hells.**

**Комментарий:**

The performer of forbidden acts of adharma obtains various results for the actions of adharma, because of various types of faith, as previously described. Performing forbidden acts out of inattention has a small amount of ignorance. If performed out of illusion, there is medium amount of ignorance. If performed out of atheism, there a full amount of ignorance. Because of the ignorance there are transformations in the form of thousands of prescribed destinations. I will describe them in detail. What is the cause? It is beginningless ignorance.

### Text 5

*ṛṣir uvāca*  
*antarāla eva tri-jagatyās tu diśi dakṣiṇasyām adhastād bhūmer upariṣṭāc ca jalād yasyām agniṣvāttādayaḥ pitṛ-gaṇā diśi svānāṁ gotrāṇāṁ parameṇa samādhinā satyā evāśiṣa āśāsānā nivasanti.*

**Перевод:**

**Śukadeva said: All the hellish planets are situated within an intermediate space within the three worlds, on the southern side of the universe, beneath the seven lower planets, and slightly above the Garbhodaka Ocean. In that direction, the Pitṛs headed by the Agiṣvāttās dwell, desiring virtuous blessings for their family members by great concentration on the Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

The Pitṛs desire peace for their family members since they identify with them.

### Text 6

*yatra ha vāva bhagavān pitṛ-rājo vaivasvataḥ sva-viṣayaṁ prāpiteṣu sva-puruṣair jantuṣu sampareteṣu yathā-karmāvadyaṁ doṣam evānullaṅghita-bhagavac-chāsanaḥ sagaṇo damaṁ dhārayati.*

**Перевод:**

**There, the king of the Pitṛs, the son of Vaivasvata named, Yamarāja, along with his followers, in obedience to the orders of the Lord, awards unavoidable punishment for sin according to the action to the living beings who have been brought to his place after death by his servants.**

**Комментарий:**

The punishment is a transformation of the sin committed. By that frightening experience he makes the *jīvas* turn towards the Lord. Yamarāja cannot avoid the orders given by Brahmā (*bhagavac-chasanaḥ*). Or *bhagavac-chāsanaḥ* means the Vedas.

### Text 10

*yas tv iha vā etad aham iti mamedam iti bhūta-droheṇa kevalaṁ sva-kuṭumbam evānudinaṁ prapuṣṇāti sa tad iha vihāya svayam eva tad-aśubhena raurave nipatati.*

**Перевод:**

**A person who, thinking in terms of me and mine, maintains his own body and the bodies of his wife and children by violence against other living entities, falls into the hell called Raurava because of that violence after giving up his body and his family.**

**Комментарий:**

He who, thinking of himself in terms of I and mine, maintains his family falls to Raurava.

### Text 11

*ye tv iha yathaivāmunā vihiṁsitā jantavaḥ paratra yama-yātanām upagataṁ ta eva ruravo bhūtvā tathā tam eva vihiṁsanti tasmād rauravam ity āhū rurur iti sarpād ati-krūra-sattvasyāpadeśaḥ.*

**Перевод:**

**The living beings that were injured by him become** ***rurus*** **and commit violence to him while he suffers the pains of Yama. Therefore this place is called Raurava. Ruru is the name of a living entity more cruel than a snake.**

**Комментарий:**

The beings which become rurus because of their acts of violence commit violence to him. Rurus are a type of animal not well known among the people.

### Text 17

*yas tv iha vai bhūtānām īśvaropakalpita-vṛttīnām avivikta-para-vyathānāṁ svayaṁ puruṣopakalpita-vṛttir vivikta-para-vyatho vyathām ācarati sa paratrāndhakūpe tad-abhidroheṇa nipatati tatra hāsau tair jantubhiḥ paśu-mṛga-pakṣi-sarīsṛpair maśaka-yūkā-matkuṇa-makṣikādibhir ye ke cābhidrugdhās taiḥ sarvato 'bhidruhyamāṇas tamasi vihata-nidrā-nirvṛtir alabdhāvasthānaḥ parikrāmati yathā kuśarīre jīvaḥ.*

**Перевод:**

**The person who, being given means of maintenance by the Lord and being aware of others’ suffering, causes suffering in this life to other entities who have no awareness of giving suffering to others and whose sustenance is arranged by the Lord from other living entities, falls to Andakūpa after death because of his violence. There he is attacked on all sides by the birds, animals, reptiles, mosquitoes, lice, worms, and flies which he injured. Without sleep or resting place, he wanders about like a living entity in a lower body.**

**Комментарий:**

Lower body (*ku-śarīre*) means animal body.

### Text 39

*śrutvā sthūlaṁ tathā sūkṣmaṁ*  
*rūpaṁ bhagavato yatiḥ*  
*sthūle nirjitam ātmānaṁ*  
*śanaiḥ sūkṣmaṁ dhiyā nayed iti*

**Перевод:**

**After hearing of the gross and subtle forms of the Lord, the renunciate, just as he leads the controlled mind by the intelligence to the gross form of the Lord, leads the mind to subtle form of the Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

Hearing of the gross and then subtle forms of the Lord, having focussed the mind on the gross form, leads the mind by steady intelligence to the subtle form. The subtle form is understood by bhakti:

*yāvan na jāyeta parāvare ’smin*  
*viśveśvare draṣṭari bhakti-yogaḥ \|*  
*tāvat sthavīyaḥ puruṣasya rūpaṁ*  
*kriyāvasāne prayataḥ smareta \|\|*

**As long as meditation on the Lord and the witness of all beings, superior to even Brahmā, which has** ***bhakti*** **as an element, does not manifest, one should remember the gross universal form after performing necessary rites of** ***karma-yoga.*** **(SB 2.2.14)**

The jīva must be endowed with the list of qualities to realize the Lord. As well it is said *mayi cānanya-yogena bhaktir avyabhicāriṇī* : knowledge means steady bhakti to me with undivided attention.

Ilāvṛta, Bhadrāśva and Ketumālā are exceptions.

He is the Manu following Vaivasvata Manu.

In the Vāyu Purāṇa three divisions are made, the northern, middle and southern paths, grouping the constellation names in these three groups of nine constellations in order. The Sun travelling on the northern path produces long days and short nights. When it travels on the middle path the days and nights are equal, and when it travels on the southern path, the days are shorter and nights are longer. In terms of sun’s placement in the constellations, then the days and nights are equal, the sun travelling on the middle path, it should be in Aśvinī, Revatī and Citrā as well as others. But in the list, only Citra is in the middle path. So the list is not related to the sun’s placement in the constellations.

This does not correspond to the diameter given in verse 7. There are 30 *muhūrtas* in a day. 95,100,000/30=3,170,000

The height of Meru above the earth plane is 84,000 yojanas. Thus the height of the axel above the earth is 90,000 yojanas, equal to its position above Mānasottara Mountain.

To cover this distance would take about 1/3 of a minute.

This is in the direction opposite the sun and the other planets.

The form of Ananta which holds up the universe is a *śaktyāveśa* form according to *Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta.*These are a class of Pitṛs.

*ṣaṣṭhaḥ skandhaḥ*  
*śrīkṛṣṇacaitaanyacandrāya namaḥ.*  
*1. śrī-kṛṣṇa-kṛṣṇa-caitanya-sa-sanātana-rūpaka!*  
*gopāla-raghunāthāpta vraja-jīvaka pāhi mām*  
*2. ṣaṣṭhasya kramasandarbhe sandarbhāṇāṁ samāhṛtiḥ*  
*kriyate yan nideśena sa me ’nanya-gater gatiḥ*

**He by whose order this collection of sandarbhas is made into the Sixth Krama Sandarbha is the goal of this person with no other goal.**

*svāmi pādair na yad vyaktaṁ yad vyaktaṁ cāsphuṭaṁ kvacit*  
*tatra tatraiva lokyo ’yaṁ sandarbhaḥ kramanāmakaḥ*

The Krama Sandarbha is understood to explain what was not explained by Śrīdhara Svāmī, or which was explained unclearly.

*vaiṣṇavāparitoṣaḥ syād yatra yatra tatas tataḥ*  
*lekhyaṁ vaiṣṇava siddhānta-dākṣiṇyenaiva kiñcana*

**Whatever is not satisfying to the Vaisnavas will be written according to the Vaisnava siddhanta.**

## Canto Six

## Chapter One

### Text 1

*śrī-parīkṣid uvāca*  
*nivṛtti-mārgaḥ kathita ādau bhagavatā yathā*  
*krama-yogopalabdhena brahmaṇā yad asaṁsṛtiḥ*

**Перевод:**

**King Parīkṣit said: You have already described the path of liberation. By gradually progressing on the path properly, one ends material existence along with Brahmā.**

**Комментарий:**

What was previously stated is repeated in five verses, since it is suitable for the next topic. There are two paths leading to the next life: following the Vedas and going beyond the Vedas. The first has two types: the path of renunciation and the path of material engagement. The second path has only one type: following adharma.

In this verse the path indicates progressing gradually ((*karma-yogopalabdhena*). This does not indicate jñāna or bhakti as the path, since they yield the sādhya or a goal.

### Text 3

*adharma-lakṣaṇā nana narakāś cānuvarṇitāḥ*  
*manvantaraś ca vyākhyāta ādyaḥ svāyambhuvo yataḥ*

**Перевод:**

**You have also described the varieties of hellish life that result from impious activities, and you have described (in the Fourth Canto) the first Manvantara, which was supervised by Svāyambhuva Manu.**

**Комментарий:**

The first line describes adharma. The next line and next verse first line describe the manvantaras incidentally. *Yataḥ* means “in which, following both paths.”

### Text 4-5

*priyavratottānapador vaṁśas tac-caritāni ca*  
*dvīpa-varṣa-samudrādri- nady-udyāna-vanaspatīn*  
*dharā-maṇḍala-saṁsthānaṁ bhāga-lakṣaṇa-mānataḥ*  
*jyotiṣāṁ vivarāṇāṁ ca yathedam asṛjad vibhuḥ*

**Перевод:**

**You have described the dynasties and characteristics of King Priyavrata and King Uttānapāda, as well as the islands,** ***varṣas*****, oceans, mountains, rivers, gardens, trees, and the condition of the earth and the luminaries in the sky and the lower planets, with their divisions, characteristics and dimensions, just as the Lord created them.**

**Комментарий:**

The islands are then described in three lines. *Vivarāṇām* (holes) means of hellish planets.

### Text 6

*adhuneha mahā-bhāga yathaiva narakān naraḥ*  
*nānogra-yātanān neyāt tan me vyākhyātum arhasi*

**Перевод:**

**O greatly fortunate Śukadeva Gosvāmī! Now kindly tell me how human beings may be saved from the terrible pains of hell.**

**Комментарий:**

Now the request is made. For people there are two sādhanas. The sādhana which removes unsteadiness should be known.

### Text 7

*śrī-śuka uvāca*  
*na ced ihaivāpacitiṁ yathāṁhasaḥ*  
*kṛtasya kuryān mana-ukta-pāṇibhiḥ*  
*dhruvaṁ sa vai pretya narakān upaiti*  
*ye kīrtitā me bhavatas tigma-yātanāḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Śukadeva said: If a person does not perform atonement for sins committed by his mind, words or actions, he will certainly attain those hells which inflict intense pain after death and which were described by me.**

**Комментарий:**

Śukadeva relates other’s opinion in answer to the question, in order to establish his recommendation for atonement.

### Text 9

*śrī-rājovāca*  
*dṛṣṭa-śrutābhyāṁ yat pāpaṁ jānann apy ātmano 'hitam*  
*karoti bhūyo vivaśaḥ prāyaścittam atho katham*

**Перевод:**

**The King said: Though the** ***jīva*** **knows that sinful acts are detrimental by seeing and hearing, he helplessly commits sin again. What is the use of atonement?**

**Комментарий:**

The king asks a question.

### Text 11

*śrī-bādarāyaṇir uvāca*  
*karmaṇā karma-nirhāro na hy ātyantika iṣyate*  
*avidvad-adhikāritvāt prāyaścittaṁ vimarśanam*

**Перевод:**

**Śukadeva said: Completely counteracting sin is not at all possible by performing atonement, for the sin is committed out of ignorance. Real atonement is attaining** ***jñāna.***

**Комментарий:**

Śukadeva states his opinion.

### Text 15

*kecit kevalayā bhaktyā vāsudeva-parāyaṇāḥ*  
*aghaṁ dhunvanti kārtsnyena nīhāram iva bhāskaraḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Persons who surrender to Kṛṣṇa completely destroy sins by pure** ***bhakti*** **alone*****,*** **just as the sun destroys fog.**

**Комментарий:**

Śukadeva states his opinion. This continues till the Third Chapter. There are two types of bhakti: continuous, and occasional. The continuous variety has two types: with attachment and with raga. The occasional variety has three types: rāgābhāsa-mayī, that devoid of bhakti’s svarūpa and that which arises from abhāsa. The abhāsa is the best type of atonement. How much more continuous bhakti with attachment or raga is glorious! With that intention he speaks.

The devotees destroy sin completely (kārstnyena), including desires, by pure bhakti.

The sun represents natural bhakti. The fog represents the incidental sins, which cannot touch bhakti, as fog cannot touch the sun. By the touch of bhakti, the sings are immediately, completely destroyed.

### Text 18

*prāyaścittāni cīrṇāni nārāyaṇa-parāṅmukham*  
*na niṣpunanti rājendra surā-kumbham ivāpagāḥ*

**Перевод:**

**O King! Even great atonement does not purify persons who are opposed to Nārāyaṇa, just as many rivers do not clean a liquor pot.**

**Комментарий:**

Atonements definitely do not purify (*niṣpunanti).*

### Text 19

*sakṛn manaḥ kṛṣṇa-padāravindayor*  
*niveśitaṁ tad-guṇa-rāgi yair iha*  
*na te yamaṁ pāśa-bhṛtaś ca tad-bhaṭān*  
*svapne 'pi paśyanti hi cīrṇa-niṣkṛtāḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Persons who only once absorb their mind in Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet, even if it occurs in dreams, or even though the mind still has material attraction, do not see the servants of Yama since they have accomplished all atonement by that remembrance,.**

**Комментарий:**

The excellence of rāgābhāsa-mayī bhakti is described. Rāga here means ratyābhāsa (likeness to rati or bhava). If real rati arises, then one would continually absorb the mind in the Lord. This verse describes once only thinking of the Lord’s feet.

*bhuvi puru-puṇya-tīrtha-sadanāny ṛṣayo vimadās*  
*ta uta bhavat-padāmbuja-hṛdo ’gha-bhid-aṅghri-jalāḥ*  
*dadhati sakṛn manas tvayi ya ātmani nitya-sukhe*  
*na punar upāsate puruṣa-sāra-harāvasathān*

**Sages free from false pride live on this earth by frequenting the sacred pilgrimage sites. Because such devotees keep your lotus feet within their hearts, the water that washes their feet destroys all sins. Having turned their minds toward you, the ever-blissful soul of all existence, they no longer dedicate themselves to serving family life at home, which simply robs a man of his good qualities. (SB 10.87 35)**

The person has slight attachment according to Śrīdhara Svāmī, but no knowledge or proper realization. This is superior to the previous methods. The servants of Yama cannot even glance at persons with bhaky-ābhāsa. This shows bhakti’s power.

### Text 20

*atra codāharantīmam itihāsaṁ purātanam*  
*dūtānāṁ viṣṇu-yamayoḥ saṁvādas taṁ nibodha me*

**Перевод:**

**Concerning this subject, the wise cite the ancient story of Ajāmila. Please here from me that story in which there is a conversation between the servants of Viṣṇu and Yama.**

**Комментарий:**

He relates a story of show the greater power of real bhakti.

### Text 24

*tasya pravayasaḥ putrā daśa teṣāṁ tu yo 'vamaḥ*  
*bālo nārāyaṇo nāmnā pitroś ca dayito bhṛśam*

**Перевод:**

**That old man Ajāmila had ten sons, of whom the youngest was named Nārāyaṇa. He was the object of affection of both his father and mother.**

**Комментарий:**

The mother and father became successful.

### Text 40

*yamadūtā ūcuḥ*  
*veda-praṇihito dharmo hy adharmas tad-viparyayaḥ*  
*vedo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt svayambhūr iti śuśruma*

**Перевод:**

**The Yamadūtas replied: Acts which are prescribed in the Vedas constitute** ***dharma,*** **and acts which are not prescribed by the Vedas are** ***adharma.*** **The Vedas are directly Nārāyaṇa and are born from him. This we have heard from Yamarāja.**

**Комментарий:**

*Praṇihitaḥ* means prescribed. The Vedas are Nārāyaṇa personally (*sākṣāt*), and thus born from him.

### Text 41

*yena sva-dhāmny amī bhāvā rajaḥ-sattva-tamomayāḥ*  
*guṇa-nāma-kriyā-rūpair vibhāvyante yathā-tatham*

**Перевод:**

**By the will of Nārāyaṇa who is situated in his own abode, these living entities composed of** ***rajas, sattva*** **and** ***tamas*** **make their appearance very precisely with qualities, names and actions.**

**Комментарий:**

*Yena* means “by the supreme cause.”

### Text 42

*sūryo 'gniḥ khaṁ marud devaḥ somaḥ sandhyāhanī diśaḥ*  
*kaṁ kuḥ svayaṁ dharma iti hy ete daihyasya sākṣiṇaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**By the will of Nārāyaṇa, the sun, fire, sky, air, the** ***devatās,*** **moon, evening, day, night, the directions, water, land and Yamarāja—who are the witnesses of the activities of the living entity—make their appearance.**

**Комментарий:**

The witnesses are mentioned in the following:

*āditya-candrāv anilo ‘nalaś ca*  
*dyaur bhumir āpo hṛdayaṁ yamaśc a*  
*ahaśca rātriś ca ubhe ca sandhye*  
*dharmo ’pi jānāti narasya vṛttam*

**The sun, moon, air, fire, sky, earth, water, mind, Yama, day, night, dawn and twilight and the Lord know the actions of man. (Viṣṇu-dharma 55.14)**

They witness the good and bad actions of men.

### Text 43

*etair adharmo vijñātaḥ sthānaṁ daṇḍasya yujyate*  
*sarve karmānurodhena daṇḍam arhanti kāriṇaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**By these witnesses, acts of** ***adharma*** **can be understood, and the cause of punishment is determined. All performs of sin deserve punishment according to the act.**

**Комментарий:**

*Yujyate* means “arises.”

### Text 46

*yatheha deva-pravarās trai-vidhyam upalabhyate*  
*bhūteṣu guṇa-vaicitryāt tathānyatrānumīyate*

**Перевод:**

**O best of the** ***devas*****! Just as there are three types of people in this world according to the variety of** ***guṇas,*** **so in next life as well one can infer such types.**

**Комментарий:**

Even humans can infer these types.

### Text 47

*vartamāno 'nyayoḥ kālo guṇābhijñāpako yathā*  
*evaṁ janmānyayor etad dharmādharma-nidarśanam*

**Перевод:**

**Just as the qualities at the present time make known the qualities of the past and the future, the qualities of** ***dharma*** **and** ***adharma*** **in this birth indicate those qualities in past and future lives.**

**Комментарий:**

The present time, dawn or spring (*vartamānaḥ*), indicates portions of qualities of the previous time such as night or dewy season and also later time, such as daytime or summer. Similarly the present birth indicates the previous birth and future birth.

### Text 48

*manasaiva pure devaḥ pūrva-rūpaṁ vipaśyati*  
*anumīmāṁsate 'pūrvaṁ manasā bhagavān ajaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Yamarāja, living in his city, sees by his mind the previous condition of a living entity. Knowing everything like Brahmā, he then decides the present and future forms by his mind.**

**Комментарий:**

Yamarāja is called *bhagavān ajaḥ* because he is considered non-different from the Lord because he is a vibhūti of the Lord by his devotion.

### Text 54

*labdhvā nimittam avyaktaṁ vyaktāvyaktaṁ bhavaty uta*  
*yathā-yoni yathā-bījaṁ svabhāvena balīyasā*

**Перевод:**

**The gross and subtle bodies, appear with a particular nature according to the** ***jīva’s karmas*** **through the womb and semen.**

**Комментарий:**

The body arises according to the nature of the womb and semen received by karma.

### Text 55

*eṣa prakṛti-saṅgena puruṣasya viparyayaḥ*  
*āsīt sa eva na cirād īśa-saṅgād vilīyate*

**Перевод:**

**This unfortunate position of the** ***jīva*** **has existed by association with** ***prakṛti.*** **That condition is quickly destroyed by association with the Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

This is similar to the following verse:

*bhayaṁ dvitīyābhiniveśataḥ syād*  
*īśād apetasya viparyayo 'smṛtiḥ*  
*tan-māyayāto budha ābhajet taṁ*  
*bhaktyaikayeśaṁ guru-devate ātmā*

**For the** ***jīva*** **averse to the Lord, there will be** ***saṁsāra*** **consisting of identity with body and lack of identity with the soul, because of his absorption in the material coverings on the soul, arising from the Lord’s** ***māyā.*** **Therefore, the intelligent person, taking** ***guru*** **as his Lord and very self, should fully worship the Lord with pure** ***bhakti.*** **(SB 11.2 37)**

### Text 56-57

*ayaṁ hi śruta-sampannaḥ śīla-vṛtta-guṇālayaḥ*  
*dhṛta-vrato mṛdur dāntaḥ satya-vāṅ mantra-vic chuciḥ*  
*gurv-agny-atithi-vṛddhānāṁ śuśrūṣur anahaṅkṛtaḥ*  
*sarva-bhūta-suhṛt sādhur mita-vāg anasūyakaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Ajāmila was well-versed in the Vedas. He was a reservoir of good character, good conduct and good qualities. Firmly established in executing all the Vedic injunctions, he was very mild and gentle, and kept his mind and senses under control. Furthermore, he was always truthful, knew how to chant the Vedic** ***mantras*****, and was also very pure. Ajāmila was respectful to his** ***guru,*** **the fire-god, guests, and the elderly members of his household. He was free from pride, was upright, benevolent to all living entities, well-behaved, controlled in speech, and without hatred to anyone.**

**Комментарий:**

Śukadeva shows in this section that though Ajāmila was not protected from falling by being fixed in his dharma, he was protected by bhaktyābhāsa. This is mentioned in the words of the Yamadūtas.

## Chapter Two

### Text 2

*śrī-viṣṇudūtā ūcuḥ*  
*aho kaṣṭaṁ dharma-dṛśām adharmaḥ spṛśate sabhām*  
*yatrādaṇḍyeṣv apāpeṣu daṇḍo yair dhriyate vṛthā*

**Перевод:**

**The servants of Viṣṇu said: This is a calamity!** ***Adharma*** **has touched the assembly of authorities on** ***dharma,*** **where punishment is unnecessarily being given to the sinless, who are not to be punished.**

**Комментарий:**

The Yamadūtas had shown that their master as the king of dharma protected the worlds. While agreeing with this, the servants of Viṣṇu criticize them in five verses.

### Text 7

*ayaṁ hi kṛta-nirveśo janma-koṭy-aṁhasām api*  
*yad vyājahāra vivaśo nāma svasty-ayanaṁ hareḥ*

**Перевод:**

**This person has performed atonement for the sins of ten million births since he has spontaneously chanted the auspicious name of the Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

Though he previously chanted the name indicating his son only, the name had great effect.

### Text 8

*etenaiva hy aghono 'sya kṛtaṁ syād agha-niṣkṛtam*  
*yadā nārāyaṇāyeti jagāda catur-akṣaram*

**Перевод:**

**When he chanted the four syllables “Nārāyaṇa,” atonement for the sins that he committed has been accomplished.**

**Комментарий:**

“When he named his son, by uttering the Lord’s name, he destroys ten million lives of sin. And all sins committed after that time were finished as well by uttering that name once. Can that be true?” That is confirmed in this verse. Though he did not chant previously, all the previous sinful acts were also destroyed. Other means are rejected.

### Text 9-10

*stenaḥ surā-po mitra-dhrug brahma-hā guru-talpa-gaḥ*  
*strī-rāja-pitṛ-go-hantā ye ca pātakino 'pare*  
*sarveṣām apy aghavatām idam eva suniṣkṛtam*  
*nāma-vyāharaṇaṁ viṣṇor yatas tad-viṣayā matiḥ*

**Перевод:**

**The chanting of the holy name of Lord Viṣṇu is the best process of atonement for a thief, for a drunkard, for one who betrays a friend or relative, for one who kills a** ***brāhmaṇa,*** **for one who indulges in sex with the wife of his** ***guru*** **or another superior, for one who kills women, the king, his father, or cows, and for all other sinful men. Simply by chanting the holy name of Lord Viṣṇu, such sinful persons attract the attention of the Supreme Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

Because of chanting Viṣṇu’s name, Viṣṇu becomes aware of that person (*tad-viṣayā matiḥ*).

### Text 11

*na niṣkṛtair uditair brahma-vādibhis*  
*tathā viśuddhyaty aghavān vratādibhiḥ*  
*yathā harer nāma-padair udāhṛtais*  
*tad uttamaśloka-guṇopalambhakam*

**Перевод:**

**A sinful man is not purified by abundant atonement, or by vows mentioned by Manu and others, as much as he is purified by chanting even the names of the Lord, which produce realization of his qualities.**

**Комментарий:**

He is not purified by karma-kāṇḍa alone (*brahma-vādibhiḥ*) as much as he is purified by chanting words in the form of the nāma (*nāma-padaiḥ*).

*vipro rājanya-vaiśyau vā hareḥ prāptāḥ padāntikam*  
*śrautena janmanāthāpi muhyanty āmnāya-vādinaḥ*

**On the other hand,** ***brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas*** **and** ***vaiśyas,*** **even after being allowed to study the Vedas by receiving Vedic initiation, become bewildered since they interpret the meaning of the Vedas. (SB 11.5.5)**

By chanting one name, there is realization of the qualities of the Lord, with additional words of description.

### Text 12

*naikāntikaṁ tad dhi kṛte 'pi niṣkṛte*  
*manaḥ punar dhāvati ced asat-pathe*  
*tat karma-nirhāram abhīpsatāṁ harer*  
*guṇānuvādaḥ khalu sattva-bhāvanaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Since even after atonement the mind again pursues material enjoyment, for people desiring complete destruction of material desire, continuous chanting of the qualities of the Lord is the only means of purification.**

**Комментарий:**

Not only the name, but the qualities of the Lord have this effect. That is explained in this verse.

### Text 13

*athainaṁ māpanayata kṛtāśeṣāgha-niṣkṛtam*  
*yad asau bhagavan-nāma mriyamāṇaḥ samagrahīt*

**Перевод:**

**Therefore, do not take away Ajāmila who has performed unlimited atonement. Because of being sinless, he has perfectly chanted the name of the Lord while dying.**

**Комментарий:**

Even though he is dying, he chanted the name. It is not necessary at that time alone to chant, since the name has power as described in the next verse.

### Text 14

*sāṅketyaṁ pārihāsyaṁ vā stobhaṁ helanam eva vā*  
*vaikuṇṭha-nāma-grahaṇam aśeṣāgha-haraṁ viduḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Chanting the name of the Lord while indicating someone else or while joking in a friendly manner, or chanting the Lord’s name in order to fill up space while chanting verses or chanting with neglect destroys unlimited sins and desires.**

**Комментарий:**

*Parihāsa* is words filled with affection for the Lord meant to humiliate another person. There is no criticism of the Lord. It is also called *upahāsa* (mocking). It is joking using the Lord’s name. *Helanam* means using words with neglect. One does not chant with attention. This also is not uttered with disrespect. Thus if Veṇa did not chant with disrespect, it would not have fault. There is fault in teaching to persons devoid of faith. But some say that even if it generates offense, it destroys old sins.

### Text 15

*patitaḥ skhalito bhagnaḥ sandaṣṭas tapta āhataḥ*  
*harir ity avaśenāha pumān nārhati yātanāḥ*

**Перевод:**

**A person who chants the name of the Lord while falling from a cliff, stumbling on the road, receiving injury his body, being bitten by snakes, tormented with fever or being attacked with sticks will not suffer hellish punishment.**

**Комментарий:**

Not only the above mentioned chanting has effect. With a desire to destroy certain sufferings if the Lord’s name is chanted, sins are destroyed. Sometimes *yātanā* is seen instead of *yātanāḥ.*

### Text 16

*gurūṇāṁ ca laghūnāṁ ca gurūṇi ca laghūni ca*  
*prāyaścittāni pāpānāṁ jñātvoktāni maharṣibhiḥ*

**Перевод:**

**The great sages, understanding the limited nature of atonements, have said that severe atonements are prescribed for grave sins, and light atonements are prescribed for minor sins.**

### Text 17

*tais tāny aghāni pūyante tapo-dāna-vratādibhiḥ*  
*nādharmajaṁ tad-dhṛdayaṁ tad apīśāṅghri-sevayā*

**Перевод:**

**Sins are destroyed by austerity, charity and vows but the root of sin is not destroyed. However by** ***bhakti*** **to the Lord, even the root of sin, namely desire, is destroyed.**

**Комментарий:**

Whatever atonements are prescribed destroy sins, but desire is destroyed by service to the Lord.

### Text 18

*ajñānād athavā jñānād uttamaśloka-nāma yat*  
*saṅkīrtitam aghaṁ puṁso dahed edho yathānalaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Chanting the name of the Lord with or without knowledge of its powers destroys a man’s sins, just as fire destroys dry grass.**

**Комментарий:**

Therefore, consciously or unconsciously chanting the Lord’s name burns up the sins of any man, like fire burns up wood completely.

### Text 19

*yathāgadaṁ vīryatamam upayuktaṁ yadṛcchayā*  
*ajānato 'py ātma-guṇaṁ kuryān mantro 'py udāhṛtaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Just as powerful medicine when taken without knowledge of its powers still produces its effects quickly, so chanting the name of the Lord also produces effects quickly, without knowing its powers.**

**Комментарий:**

*Mantra* here means the name of the Lord. Normal mantras require faith and other elements to be effective. The name does not depend on that. The word *mantra* is used to indicate its main function (purification). Or this verse continues the example given in the previous verse.

### Text 20

*śrī-śuka uvāca*  
*ta evaṁ suvinirṇīya dharmaṁ bhāgavataṁ nṛpa*  
*taṁ yāmya-pāśān nirmucya vipraṁ mṛtyor amūmucan*

**Перевод:**

**Śukadeva Gosvāmī said: O King! Having thus perfectly defined the principles of devotional service with reasoning and arguments, the order carriers of Lord Viṣṇu released the** ***brāhmaṇa*** **Ajāmila, from the bondage of the Yamadūtas and saved him from death.**

**Комментарий:**

Though the servants of Yama did not have complete knowledge, the servants of Viṣṇu explained expertly (*suvinirnīya*). The name even if chanted accidently (verses 13) once in nāmābhāsa destroys unlimited sins and even desires. Verse 12 indicates practice of bhakti. This is worship without offenses.

*nāmāparādha-yuktānāṁ nāmāny eva haranty agham \|*  
*aviśrānta-prayuktāni tāny evārtha-karāṇi ca \|\|*

**For those who have committed offenses to the name, chanting the name incessantly will be effective in destroying that sin. (Padma Purāṇa)**

Though the name is completely independent, it is an offense to chant it as an aṅga of karma, for accruing piety. To equate the name with pious acts is an offense mentioned in the Padma Purāṇa. However such offenses are nullified by worship of the Lord:

*tais tāny aghāni pūyante tapo-dāna-vratādibhiḥ*  
*nādharmajaṁ tad-dhṛdayaṁ tad apīśāṅghri-sevayā*

**Sins are destroyed by austerity, charity and vows but the root of sin is not destroyed. However by** ***bhakti*** **to the Lord, even the root of sin, namely desire, is destroyed. (SB 6.2.17)**

If that is so, why did Ajāmila not immediately go to Vaikuṇṭha as an associate, since while dying he chanted the name? It is said:

*yasyāvatāra-guṇa-karma-viḍambanāni*  
*nāmāni ye ’su-vigame vivaśā gṛṇanti*  
*te ’naika-janma-śamalaṁ sahasaiva hitvā*  
*saṁyānty apāvṛtāmṛtaṁ tam ajaṁ prapadye*

**I surrender to the Lord without birth, whose names, invested with the powers of the Lord’s qualities and activities, chanted at the point of death even without attention, immediately destroy lifetimes of sins and allow men to achieve the uncovered, true form of the Lord. (SB 3.9.15)**

But there are two types of chanting the name: kevala (without affection) and sneha-saṁyukta (with affection). The first type keeps the person from going to hell and the second gives nearness to the Lord.

*mayi bhaktir hi bhūtānām amṛtatvāya kalpate*  
*diṣṭyā yad āsīn mat-sneho bhavatīnāṁ mad-āpanaḥ*

**Rendering devotional service to me qualifies any living being for eternal life. But your** ***prema*** **for me, which has existed to bring the highest fortune, has caused you to attain me directly. (SB 10.82.44)**

But also it is said that the Lord delays in giving his affection:

*nāhaṁ tu sakhyo bhajato ’pi jantūn*  
*bhajāmy amīṣām anuvṛtti-vṛttaye*  
*yathādhano labdha-dhane vinaṣṭe*  
*tac-cintayānyan nibhṛto na veda*

**But the reason I do not immediately reciprocate the affection of living beings even when they worship Me, O** ***gopīs,*** **is that I want to intensify their loving devotion. They then become like a poor man who has gained some wealth and then lost it, and who thus becomes so anxious about it that he can think of nothing else. (SB 10.32.20)**

*Amīṣam anuvṛtti* means affection, or continual service which is one’s very life. Thus even Ajāmila had affection in chanting the name because it was also the name of his son.

The Lord has great identity with his own name for it was said in verse 10 that the Lord is attracted to the person who chants (*tad-viṣayā matiḥ*). Since it is said the even the associates have great respect for such persons, the Lord gives his affection to a person when that person chants with longing while uttering the Lord’s name with affection, and desires to take the devotee. The servants of Viṣṇu understood this and thus took him with them forcibly.

### Text 23

*taṁ vivakṣum abhipretya mahāpuruṣa-kiṅkarāḥ*  
*sahasā paśyatas tasya tatrāntardadhire 'nagha*

**Перевод:**

**O sinless Parīkṣit! Knowing that Ajāmila wanted to speak to them, the servants of the Lord suddenly disappeared while he watched.**

**Комментарий:**

They left in order that he take up the practice of bhakti which would increase his desire to speak to them.

### Text 26

*aho me paramaṁ kaṣṭam abhūd avijitātmanaḥ*  
*yena viplāvitaṁ brahma vṛṣalyāṁ jāyatātmanā*

**Перевод:**

**Oh! With uncontrolled senses I have fallen into a miserable condition, by which I destroyed my status as a** ***brāhmaṇa*** **by bearing sons in a** ***śūdra*** **woman.**

**Комментарий:**

His worship while developing longing is shown. This continues till verse 38.

### Text 29

*so 'haṁ vyaktaṁ patiṣyāmi narake bhṛśa-dāruṇe*  
*dharma-ghnāḥ kāmino yatra vindanti yama-yātanāḥ*

**Перевод:**

**I will certainly fall to a most terrifying hell where those who destroy** ***dharma*** **and are full of lust undergo torture by Yamarāja.**

**Комментарий:**

Seeing his previous faults and the power of the name, he speaks. He would have otherwise died.

### Text 32

*athāpi me durbhagasya vibudhottama-darśane*  
*bhavitavyaṁ maṅgalena yenātmā me prasīdati*

**Перевод:**

**Though most sinful, I must have done some auspicious acts to see those best of** ***devatās,*** **by which I have become joyful.**

**Комментарий:**

I must have had some previous bhakti, but by some offense it became covered up.

### Text 39

*iti jāta-sunirvedaḥ kṣaṇa-saṅgena sādhuṣu*  
*gaṅgā-dvāram upeyāya mukta-sarvānubandhanaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Thus becoming detached from material life by association with the servants of Viṣṇu, Ajāmila, free from attachment to wife and sons, went to Haridvāra.**

**Комментарий:**

Having describes the results of chanting, up to devotee association, now the special result of association is described. He became detached in association by performing bhakti.

### Text 40

*sa tasmin deva-sadana āsīno yogam āsthitaḥ*  
*pratyāhṛtendriya-grāmo yuyoja mana ātmani*

**Перевод:**

**Sitting in a temple of Viṣṇu, he practices** ***bhakti-yoga,*** **and, controlling all his senses, concentrated his mind on the Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

He thought that he would concentrate his mind on the Lord for purification (verse 38). With a vision of the Lord in his purified mind, he thought that even with such a mind one cannot attain the Lord. The Lord with qualities is superior to Brahman. *Brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāham*: I am the basis of Brahman. (BG 14. 27) Thus he first decided to endeavor for realizing impersonal Brahman. The next result would be accomplished by the merciful Lord. This was his thought. His actions for that goal are described in two verses. (He meditated on Brahman).

### Text 42

*yarhy upārata-dhīs tasminn adrākṣīt puruṣān puraḥ*  
*upalabhyopalabdhān prāg vavande śirasā dvijaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**When his intelligence became fixed on the form of the Lord, he saw the persons before him whom he had previously seen. Seeing them, he bowed his head.**

**Комментарий:**

After realizing Brahman, he was able to realize the wealth of Vaikuṇṭha.

### Text 45

*evaṁ sa viplāvita-sarva-dharmā*  
*dāsyāḥ patiḥ patito garhya-karmaṇā*  
*nipātyamāno niraye hata-vrataḥ*  
*sadyo vimukto bhagavan-nāma gṛhṇan*

**Перевод:**

**Having given up all** ***dharma*****, becoming the husband of a prostitute, degrading himself by the most condemned actions, having broken all vows and in the process of being thrown to hell, he was immediately liberated on chanting the name of the Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

*Sadyo vimuktaḥ* means he became a jīvanmukta.

### Text 47-48

*ya etaṁ paramaṁ guhyam itihāsam aghāpaham*  
*śṛṇuyāc chraddhayā yukto yaś ca bhaktyānukīrtayet*  
*na vai sa narakaṁ yāti nekṣito yama-kiṅkaraiḥ*  
*yady apy amaṅgalo martyo viṣṇu-loke mahīyate*

**Перевод:**

**The person who faithfully hears this most confidential story which destroys sin, or who recites this story with devotion, does not go to hell and is not seen by the servants of Yama, even if he was a nāmāparādhi. Rather he goes to the abode of the Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

If one has committed offenses to the name, two verses describe the remedy. *Amaṅgalaḥ* means he had committed offenses to the name.

### Text 49

*mriyamāṇo harer nāma gṛṇan putropacāritam*  
*ajāmilo 'py agād dhāma kim uta śraddhayā gṛṇan*

**Перевод:**

**Ajāmila, by chanting the name of the Lord to indicate his son while dying, attained the abode of the Lord. What then will happen if one chants with faith?**

**Комментарий:**

The example is given.

## Chapter Three

### Text 2

*yamasya devasya na daṇḍa-bhaṅgaḥ*  
*kutaścanarṣe śruta-pūrva āsīt*  
*etan mune vṛścati loka-saṁśayaṁ*  
*na hi tvad-anya iti me viniścitam*

**Перевод:**

**O sage! Previously it has not been heard from anyone that the punishment of Yama can be avoided. I have concluded that, other than you, no one can eradicate this doubt.**

**Комментарий:**

This is the doubt of people (*loka-saṁsayam*). He does not have that doubt however.

### Text 10

*tāṁs te veditum icchāmo yadi no manyase kṣamam*  
*nārāyaṇety abhihite mā bhair ity āyayur drutam*

**Перевод:**

**If you think it beneficial for us, we would like to know about these persons. When Ajāmila cried out “Nārāyaṇa” they quickly came and said “Do not fear.”**

**Комментарий:**

Their activities should be described a little, to know who they were. Thus they describe the servants of Viṣṇu.

### Text 11

*iti devaḥ sa āpṛṣṭaḥ prajā-saṁyamano yamaḥ*  
*prītaḥ sva-dūtān pratyāha smaran pādāmbujaṁ hareḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Thus being questioned, Yamarāja, the controller of the living entities, was very pleased and replied to his order carriers while remembering the lotus feet of the Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

First he thought they were someone else’s servants and became upset. Now he understood from the description that they were servants of Nārāyaṇa, and became pleased.

### Text 16

*yaṁ vai na gobhir manasāsubhir vā*  
*hṛdā girā vāsu-bhṛto vicakṣate*  
*ātmānam antar-hṛdi santam ātmanāṁ*  
*cakṣur yathaivākṛtayas tataḥ param*

**Перевод:**

**As forms cannot know the eye, the living entities cannot know the Supreme Lord, who is situated as the Supersoul in everyone's heart, by the knowledge senses, by the mind, by the action senses, by consciousness without thought, or by words.**

**Комментарий:**

The form of the Lord is described by scriptures, since it is beyond words and mind. That form is self-revealing. They do not perceive the Lord by senses and mind (*vicakṣate*).

### Text 20-21

*svayambhūr nāradaḥ śambhuḥ kumāraḥ kapilo manuḥ*  
*prahlādo janako bhīṣmo balir vaiyāsakir vayam*  
*dvādaśaite vijānīmo dharmaṁ bhāgavataṁ bhaṭāḥ*  
*guhyaṁ viśuddhaṁ durbodhaṁ yaṁ jñātvāmṛtam aśnute*

**Перевод:**

**My dear servants! Lord Brahmā, Nārada, Lord Śiva, the four Kumāras, Lord Kapila, Svāyambhuva Manu, Prahlāda Mahārāja, Janaka Mahārāja, Bhīṣma, Bali Mahārāja, Śukadeva Gosvāmī and I myself know** ***bhāgavata-dharma*****, which is confidential, pure, and difficult to comprehend. Knowing this, one attains immortality.**

**Комментарий:**

We know this dharma. We do not speak it clearly, in our own smṛti scriptures, since it is secret, in order to preserve normal etiquette. It is moreover difficult to understand by ordinary people. That is because it is pure. Impure persons cannot understand what is pure. It is secret because it gives immortality. O servants! Thus you also do not know.

### Text 22

*etāvān eva loke 'smin puṁsāṁ dharmaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ*  
*bhakti-yogo bhagavati tan-nāma-grahaṇādibhiḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Pure** ***bhakti*** **to the Supreme Lord, beginning with the chanting of the holy name of the Lord, is the real** ***dharma*****, the supreme object for the human living in this world.**

**Комментарий:**

In this material universe (*loke ‘smin*) the highest dharma is bhakti, with chanting the Lord’s name. The instrumental case indicates that chanting is the main activity of bhakti.

### Text 24

*etāvatālam agha-nirharaṇāya puṁsāṁ*  
*saṅkīrtanaṁ bhagavato guṇa-karma-nāmnām*  
*vikruśya putram aghavān yad ajāmilo 'pi*  
*nārāyaṇeti mriyamāṇa iyāya muktim*

**Перевод:**

**The attentive chanting of the names, pastimes and qualities of the Lord destroys the sins of man. But even attentive chanting is not necessary. Sinful Ajāmila, crying out for his son, uttered “Nārāyaṇa” while dying and still attained liberation.**

**Комментарий:**

Chanting repeatedly with faith is necessary to destroy the impressions of sin which remain because of committing great offenses. If one is without offense at the time of death, the name will manifest in the mouth. That was explained previously:

*etāvān sāṅkhya-yogābhyāṁ sva-dharma-pariniṣṭhayā \|*  
*janma-lābhaḥ paraḥ puṁsām ante nārāyaṇa-smṛtiḥ \|\|*

**For persons fixed in** ***jñāna, yoga*** **and** ***karma,*** **gaining such a birth, with remembrance of Nārāyaṇa while rejecting the other processes, is the best. (SB 2.1.6)**

At the end they received the highest benefit. It is said:

*kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇa ity anta-kāle*  
*jalpan jantur jīvitaṁ yo jahāti \|*  
*ādyaḥ śabdaḥ kalpate tasya muktyai*  
*vrīḍā-namrau tiṣṭhato’nyāvṛṇa-sthau \|\|*

**He who gives up his life while chanting “Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa” becomes qualitied for just by chanting the first word. (Quoted in Hari-bhakti-vilāsa)**

*Muktim iyāya* means Ajāmila first became a jīvanmukta.

### Text 25

*prāyeṇa veda tad idaṁ na mahājano 'yaṁ*  
*devyā vimohita-matir bata māyayālam*  
*trayyāṁ jaḍī-kṛta-matir madhu-puṣpitāyāṁ*  
*vaitānike mahati karmaṇi yujyamānaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Other persons, bewildered in intelligence by very powerful** ***māyā,*** **having material intelligence, engaging in great rituals with elaborate arrangements mentioned in the Vedas with flowery language, generally do not know this** ***dharma.***

**Комментарий:**

Other great persons, other than the twelve mentioned, do not know this dharma. Their intelligence is bewildered by māyā (*devyā*).

### Text 26

*evaṁ vimṛśya sudhiyo bhagavaty anante*  
*sarvātmanā vidadhate khalu bhāva-yogam*  
*te me na daṇḍam arhanty atha yady amīṣāṁ*  
*syāt pātakaṁ tad api hanty urugāya-vādaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Considering in this way, the intelligent people accept** ***bhakti-yoga*** **to the infinite Lord with complete dedication. They cannot be punished by me. If they happen to commit sin, chanting the Lord’s name destroys that sin.**

**Комментарий:**

This verse glorifies bhakti previously mentioned. *Sarvātmanā* means rejecting nitya and naimittika kriyās. They cannot be punished (because of that neglect). If by chance they commit sin by performing a forbidden act somehow or other, chanting alone destroys the fault.

### Text 27

*te deva-siddha-parigīta-pavitra-gāthā*  
*ye sādhavaḥ samadṛśo bhagavat-prapannāḥ*  
*tān nopasīdata harer gadayābhiguptān*  
*naiṣāṁ vayaṁ na ca vayaḥ prabhavāma daṇḍe*

**Перевод:**

**Do not approach those who have surrendered to the Lord, who see everything equally, who have proper conduct and who are praised with pure narrations by the** ***devatās*** **and Siddhas, since they are protected by the club of the Lord. We, including Brahmā and time, do not have the power to punish them.**

**Комментарий:**

Giving instructions, the devotees are glorified. Do not approach them even if they have committed sin.

### Text 29

*jihvā na vakti bhagavad-guṇa-nāmadheyaṁ*  
*cetaś ca na smarati tac-caraṇāravindam*  
*kṛṣṇāya no namati yac-chira ekadāpi*  
*tān ānayadhvam asato 'kṛta-viṣṇu-kṛtyān*

**Перевод:**

**Bring to me the non-devotees who have never served Viṣṇu, whose heads have never once bowed to Kṛṣṇa, whose tongues have never pronounced the name and qualities of the Lord, whose minds have never remembered his lotus feet.**

**Комментарий:**

**Bhakti Sandarbha 148:**

You should bring those whose tongues never once in this birth uttered the name of the Lord or described his qualities. If they do not have tongues, then bring those who have not remembered the lotus feet of the Lord once. If their minds are disturbed, then bring those who do not offer respects to the Lord with their heads.

*śaṭhenāpi namaskāraṁ kurvataḥ śārṅgadhanvine \|*  
*śata-janmārjitaṁ pāpaṁ tat-kṣaṇād eva naśyati \|\|*

**Those who offer respects to the Lord even with deception instantly destroy the sins of a hundred births. (Skanda Purāṇa)**

Bring those who do not offer respects. The reason they do not offer respects is that they are materialists *(asataḥ*). They are materialists because they have never done activities for the Lord.

Brahmā says:

*sa kartā sarva-dharmāṇāṁ bhakto yas tava keśava \|*  
*sa kartā sarva-pāpānāṁ yo na bhaktas tavācyuta \|\|*  
*pāpaṁ bhavati dharmo ’pi tavābhaktaiḥ kṛto hare \|*  
*niḥśeṣa-dharma-kartā vāpy abhakto narake hare \|*  
*sadā tiṣṭhati bhaktas te brahmahāpi vimucyate \|\|*

**O Keśava! Your devotee has performed all dharma. He who is not your devotee has performed all sin. O Lord! Dharma performed by the non-devotee is sin. O Lord! Though the non-devotee does unlimited dharma he remains eternally in hell. The devotee, though he kills a brāhmaṇa, is liberated. (Skanda Purāṇa)**

*man-nimittaṁ kṛtaṁ pāpam api kṣemāya kalpate \|*  
*mām anādṛtya dharmo ’pi pāpaṁ syān mat-prabhāvataḥ \|\|*

**One who has done sin by acts for me is liberated. One who performs dharma but disrespects me commits sin by my influence. (Padma Purāṇa)**

Therefore it was rightly said in SB 7.11.10 that acts of bhakti must be included in dharma (destroyers of sin). It was also said that the varṇāśrama system originates from the limbs of the Lord. (SB 11.5.2) Bhakti must always be performed as per the rule *sarva-vidhi niṣedāḥ syuḥ*: all rules and prohibitions are servants of always remembering the Lord and never forgetting him. This is the highest nitya-karma or dharmic rule.

In the absence of chanting, remembering and offering respects all other devotional actions would also be absent. Thus the verse under discussion says the person is devoid of activities for the Lord (*akṛta-viṣṇu-kṛyān*).

By mentioning the various organs as agents, the order is given for chanting, remembering and offering respects even if the person is unwilling. The lotus feet are particularly mentioned to indicate Yamarāja’s bhakti, not to make a rule of only remembering the Lord’s feet. By ordering his servants to bring the non-devotees he also orders them not to bring devotees since the order to take the non-devotees is final. *Vaivasvataṁ saṁyamanaṁ prajānām*: Yama punishes his citizens. (Ṛg Veda 10.14.1)

*sakṛn manaḥ kṛṣṇa-padāravindayor*  
*niveśitaṁ tad-guṇa-rāgi yair iha*  
*na te yamaṁ pāśa-bhṛtaś ca tad-bhaṭān*  
*svapne ’pi paśyanti hi cīrṇa-niṣkṛtāḥ*

**Persons who only once absorb their mind in Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet, even if it occurs in dreams, or even though the mind still has material attraction, do not see the servants of Yama since they have accomplished all atonement (dharma) by that remembrance. (SB 6.1.19)**

The power of remembering the Lord is such that it destroys all attraction to objects that may appear to the person (*tad-guṇa-rāgi*). Similarly it is said:

*aham amara-gaṇārcitena dhātrā*  
*yama iti loka-hitāhite niyuktaḥ \|*  
*hari-guru-vimukhān praśāsmi martyān*  
*hari-caraṇa-praṇatān namaskaromi \|\|*

**I am Yama, engaged by the Lord who is worshipped by the devatās, for punishing or rewarding people. I punish those who are averse to the Lord and offer respects to those who respect the Lord’s feet. (Nṛsiṁha Purāṇa 9.2)**

*na brahmā na śivāgnīndrā nāhaṁ nānye divaukasaḥ \|*  
*śaktās tu nigrahaṁ kartuṁ vaiṣṇavānāṁ mahātmanām \|\|*

**Brahmā, Śiva, Agni, Indra, myself (Skanda) or any devatā cannot punish the great devotees of the Lord. (Skanda Purāṇa)**

### Text 30

*tat kṣamyatāṁ sa bhagavān puruṣaḥ purāṇo*  
*nārāyaṇaḥ sv-apuruṣair yad asat kṛtaṁ naḥ*  
*svānām aho na viduṣāṁ racitāñjalīnāṁ*  
*kṣāntir garīyasi namaḥ puruṣāya bhūmne*

**Перевод:**

**May Nārāyaṇa, the Supreme Lord, the most ancient person, along with his servants, forgive me and my servants who are ignorant and who are folding our hands in humility, for improper treatment of the devotees. Forgiveness is befitting of the greatest person. I offer respects to the great Lord.**

**Комментарий:**

May Nārāyaṇa along with his door keepers (s*vapuruṣaiḥ*) forgive me and my servants for our improper treatment.

### Text 31

*tasmāt saṅkīrtanaṁ viṣṇor jagan-maṅgalam aṁhasām*  
*mahatām api kauravya viddhy aikāntika-niṣkṛtam*

**Перевод:**

**O descendent of the Kurus! Please understand that intense chanting the Lord’s name, auspicious for the universe, is the ultimate atonement for the greatest sins.**

**Комментарий:**

These are the words of Śukadeva. Therefore please know that saṅkīrtana is the best atonement for all people, whether with or without offenses, for the greatest sins including offenses.

### Text 32

*śṛṇvatāṁ gṛṇatāṁ vīryāṇy uddāmāni harer muhuḥ*  
*yathā sujātayā bhaktyā śuddhyen nātmā vratādibhiḥ*

**Перевод:**

**One who constantly hears and chants about the activities of the Lord, which can destroy sin, purifies his soul** **by that** ***bhakti.*** **One cannot achieve such purification merely by observing vows and performing Vedic ritualistic ceremonies.**

**Комментарий:**

*Sujātayā bhaktyā* means by bhakti in the form of rati. It purifies the mind (*ātmā*) not just by destroying all sins. It even bestows liberation. Vows etc. cannot purify to that extent.

### Text 33

*kṛṣṇāṅghri-padma-madhu-liṇ na punar visṛṣṭa-*  
*māyā-guṇeṣu ramate vṛjināvaheṣu*  
*anyas tu kāma-hata ātma-rajaḥ pramārṣṭum*  
*īheta karma yata eva rajaḥ punaḥ syāt*

**Перевод:**

**The person who licks the honey from the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa does not again enjoy the rejected material objects which bring distress. Any other person however, defeated by lust, performs atonement to purify the sin in the heart. From that atonement again contamination appears.**

**Комментарий:**

This is then explained. Those who are devoid of bhakti (*anyaḥ)* perform atonements.

### Text 35

*itihāsam imaṁ guhyaṁ bhagavān kumbha-sambhavaḥ*  
*kathayām āsa Malaya āsīno harim arcayan*

**Перевод:**

**The sage Agastya, the son of Kumbha, residing in the Malaya Hills and worshiping the Lord, spoke this confidential story to me.**

**Комментарий:**

*Kumbha-sambhavaḥ* is Agastya. He also told this to me. Śukadeva heard from Vyāsa the whole chapter.

## Chapter Four

### Text 1-2

*śrī-rājovāca*  
*devāsura-nṛṇāṁ sargo nāgānāṁ mṛga-pakṣiṇām*  
*sāmāsikas tvayā prokto yas tu svāyambhuve 'ntare*  
*tasyaiva vyāsam icchāmi jñātuṁ te bhagavan yathā*  
*anusargaṁ yayā śaktyā sasarja bhagavān paraḥ*

**Перевод:**

**The King said: My dear Lord! I wish to know in detail about the** ***devatās,*** **demons, human beings, Nāgas, beasts and birds created during the reign of Svāyambhuva Manu, which you described briefly in the Third Canto. I also wish to know about the** ***śakti*** **by which Brahmā produces the secondary creation.**

**Комментарий:**

He wants to know because the details of the creation during the sixth manvantara had not be narrated. I desire to know the details of the branches in the lineage from Dakṣa who arose in that manvantara (*vyāsam*). The previous creation of Brahmā had been lost from some reason. Thus he inquires about Brahmā’s creation again (*anusargam*).

### Text 4

*śrī-śuka uvāca*  
*yadā pracetasaḥ putrā daśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ*  
*antaḥ-samudrād unmagnā dadṛśur gāṁ drumair vṛtām*

**Перевод:**

**Śukadeva Gosvāmī said: When the ten sons of Prācīnabarhi emerged from the waters, they saw that the entire world was covered with trees.**

**Комментарий:**

This is a description of what happened after Uttānapāda finished ruling. After that, no one was ruling. Thus the tress covered the world.

### Text 8

*aho prajāpati-patir bhagavān harir avyayaḥ*  
*vanaspatīn oṣadhīś ca sasarjorjam iṣaṁ vibhuḥ*

**Перевод:**

**The powerful, indestructible Supreme Lord, the master of the progenitors, has created the trees and grass with fruits and grains.**

**Комментарий:**

*Ūrjam* refers to eatables other than grains.

### Text 9

*annaṁ carāṇām acarā hy apadaḥ pāda-cāriṇām*  
*ahastā hasta-yuktānāṁ dvi-padāṁ ca catuṣ-padaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Non-moving plants are food for the moving beings. Beings without legs are food for those with legs. Animals without hands are food for animals with hands. The animals with four legs and plants are food for the human being.**

**Комментарий:**

He created food for strong and weak moving beings.

### Text 23

*śrī-prajāpatir uvāca*  
*namaḥ parāyāvitathānubhūtaye*  
*guṇa-trayābhāsa-nimitta-bandhave*  
*adṛṣṭa-dhāmne guṇa-tattva-buddhibhir*  
*nivṛtta-mānāya dadhe svayambhuve*

**Перевод:**

**Dakṣa said: I offer respects to the self-born Lord, superior to the** ***jīva*** **and** **to** ***māyā*** **and its products, who is real knowledge, who inspires the** ***jīva*** **and matter to act, who has a form unseen by the** ***jīva*** **whose intelligence is absorbed in material objects, and who cannot be known.**

**Комментарий:**

The Lord and no other should be worshipped either with desires (higher or lower) or without desires. Since he has śaktis which control māyā and the jīva, other beings have insignificant śakti dependent on māyā. With that purpose, Dakṣa worshipped with Lord with verses of praise.

The Lord has true perception (*avitathānubhūtaye).* This means his jñāna and icchā śaktis are constant in serving him. He inspires the jīvas and māyā to act. This indicates his kriyā-śakti. Since the śaktis controls māyā and the jīva, they arise from his svarūpa, beyond māyā and the jīvas. His form is unseen (*adṛṣṭa-dhamne*). It is impossible to conceive by persons whose knowledge (*tattva-buddhi*) is in the material guṇas. What to speak of realizing that form (*nivṛtta-mānāya*), which manifests such śaktis, a form full of śaktis arising from his svarūpa (*dhāmne*). This is because the form is self-manifesting (*svayambhuve*). The jīva is covered by ignorance (*guṇa-trayābhāsa*). It is clear that the jīva is inferior, and an ābhāsa, since he is touched by ignorance, though he is conscious. He is like a ray of the sun.

### Text 25

*deho 'savo 'kṣā manavo bhūta-mātrām*  
*ātmānam anyaṁ ca viduḥ paraṁ yat*  
*sarvaṁ pumān veda guṇāṁś ca taj-jño*  
*na veda sarva-jñam anantam īḍe*

**Перевод:**

**The body, life airs, senses, internal senses, gross elements and sense objects do not know themselves or other things or the** ***jīva.*** **The** ***jīva*** **knows all of these items and the** ***guṇas*** **which cause them. He also can know Paramātmā, but does not really know the omniscient Lord. I worship that Lord with infinite qualities.**

**Комментарий:**

The body and senses do not know the devatās or other humans (*anyam*).

### Text 26

*yadoparāmo manaso nāma-rūpa-*  
*rūpasya dṛṣṭa-smṛti-sampramoṣāt*  
*ya īyate kevalayā sva-saṁsthayā*  
*haṁsāya tasmai śuci-sadmane namaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to the pure Lord, perceived by the pure mind, who is perceived by his svarūpa-śakti when the mind which defines names and forms enters** ***samādhi*** **because of complete destruction of seeing and remembering material objects.**

**Комментарий:**

*Sva-saṁsthayā* means by svarūpa-śakti.

### Text 27-28

*manīṣiṇo 'ntar-hṛdi sanniveśitaṁ*  
*sva-śaktibhir navabhiś ca trivṛdbhiḥ*  
*vahniṁ yathā dāruṇi pāñcadaśyaṁ*  
*manīṣayā niṣkarṣanti gūḍham*  
*sa vai mamāśeṣa-viśeṣa-māyā-*  
*niṣedha-nirvāṇa-sukhānubhūtiḥ*  
*sa sarva-nāmā sa ca viśva-rūpaḥ*  
*prasīdatām aniruktātma-śaktiḥ*

**Перевод:**

**Just as persons manifest fire from wood through** ***mantras*****, the pure devotees, after bringing the personal form of Lord into the heart by hearing, manifest him before their eyes along with his nine and three spiritual** ***śaktis*** **by their** ***prema-bhakti.*** **May that Lord who is realized as bliss without material suffering, devoid of the unlimited varieties of** ***māyā,*** **who is all names and all forms in the universe by his external energy, and who has his spiritual energy beyond mind and words, be pleased with me.**

**Комментарий:**

“Since I am beyond the three and nine śaktis, am I without śakti?” That is not so.

He must be conceived of as blissful, devoid of material suffering (*sukhānubhūtiḥ*). Without that realization of bliss, he could not be the goal or puruṣārtha. By accept this realization of his bliss, one accepts his svarūpa-śakti, with its various aspects. Because of this Dakṣa can say “Be pleased with me.” If he is distinct from his śaktis, how can he embody all names and forms? He has acintya-śakti (*aniruktātma-śaktiḥ*).

### Text 29

*yad yan niruktaṁ vacasā nirūpitaṁ*  
*dhiyākṣabhir vā manasota yasya*  
*mā bhūt svarūpaṁ guṇa-rūpaṁ hi tat tat*  
*sa vai guṇāpāya-visarga-lakṣaṇaḥ*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to the Lord manifesting forms and qualities, who cannot be defined by words, intelligence, senses or mind, and who can only be inferred from the creation and destruction of matter.**

**Комментарий:**

“Just realize my form as Brahman, a form of complete bliss. Why bother with three and nine śaktis?” Is that svarūpa full qualities and forms similar to those of the material world? Three verses explain this form.

That svarūpa is full of qualities and forms, unequaled in greatness (*guṇa-rūpaṁ svarūpam*). It is not an object subject to words, senses, mind or intelligence, because that svarūpa full of qualities and forms is only inferred (*lakṣaṇaḥ*) by creation and destruction of the guṇas, and not realized. Or that form is seen in eternal Vaikuṇṭha (*visarga*), in which the guṇas are absent (*guṇāpāya*) since he is its controller.

### Text 30

*yasmin yato yena ca yasya yasmai*  
*yad yo yathā kurute kāryate ca*  
*parāvareṣāṁ paramaṁ prāk prasiddhaṁ*  
*tad brahma tad dhetur ananyad ekam*

**Перевод:**

**Brahman is the supreme cause, ever existing, of all lower and higher causes, in which, from which, by which, of which, unto which everything occurs, who does everything, and who is the desired object of all action. Brahman alone, and nothing else, exists.**

**Комментарий:**

That is shown in this verse.

### Text 31

*yac-chaktayo vadatāṁ vādināṁ vai*  
*vivāda-saṁvāda-bhuvo bhavanti*  
*kurvanti caiṣāṁ muhur ātma-mohaṁ*  
*tasmai namo 'nanta-guṇāya bhūmne*

**Перевод:**

**I offer respects to the great Lord of eternal qualities, whose material energy is the cause of agreement and disagreement among those who make philosophies and then argue with others, and whose material energy continually bewilders them as to the real nature of** ***ātmā.***

**Комментарий:**

The Lord is the cause of various speculative arguments of persons who falsely maintain one point and other persons who argue with those points. This is because he has unlimited qualities and wealth.

### Text 32

*astīti nāstīti ca vastu-niṣṭhayor*  
*eka-sthayor bhinna-viruddha-dharmaṇoḥ*  
*avekṣitaṁ kiñcana yoga-sāṅkhyayoḥ*  
*samaṁ paraṁ hy anukūlaṁ bṛhat tat*

**Перевод:**

**The same supreme Brahman without contradiction is perceived by** ***bhakti*** **and** ***jñāna*** **with contrary qualities because the followers are fixed in a particular faith directed to the same object.**

**Комментарий:**

In the arguments, the Lord’s svarūpa full of qualities and forms is the conclusion. That is explained in this verse.

**Bhagavat Sandarbha 51:**

*Yoga* refers to scriptures which advocate worship of a gross form (*asti*). When the name and form of the Lord are mentioned in scriptures, they meditate on all material names like pot and cloth and think of Pātāla as the Lord’s feet from rash imagination arising from visible objects. Sāṅkhya refers to jñāna scriptures which advocate no form (*nāsti)*. Since the scriptures forbid names and forms, they forbid all name and form for the Lord since they can conceive of only material names and forms. These two types of worship were previously described in the same chapter. *Sa sarva-nāmā sa ca viśva-rūpaḥ*: the Lord is all names and all forms in the universe by his external energy. *Yad yan niruktaṁ vacasā:* his form cannot be defined by words *(nirūpitam*). (SB 6.4.28-29)

Some are fixed in these two concepts (*vastuni niṣṭhāyoḥ*). This produces quarrel. The two parties have contrary qualities (*viruddha-dharmanoḥ*) because of different concepts (*bhinna*) of *asti* and *nāsti.*

“They are arguing about different objects.” No. The two have the same object (*eka-sthayoḥ*). In this quarrel, the object perceived through agreement or compromise (*samam*) should be very favorable for both. What is the agreement? It is a different type of entity *(param*), since it does not have name and form and also has name and form. That object which simultaneously possesses and does not possess name and form is different.

This should be said. Scriptures should cancel each other by advocating name and form or forbidding name and form in one object. Based on the previous reasoning that the supreme Lord had name and form and did not have name and form, the only solution is that the Lord has non-material name and form. This agrees with the conclusions of both types of scripture. They simply quarrel over their positions.

Dhruva has stated the position of no conflict:

*tiryaṅ-naga-dvija-sarīsṛpa-deva-daitya-*  
*martyādibhiḥ paricitaṁ sad-asad-viśeṣam*  
*rūpaṁ sthaviṣṭham aja te mahad-ādy-anekaṁ*  
*nātaḥ paraṁ parama vedmi na yatra vādaḥ*

**O unborn Lord! Previously I knew the variety of gross and subtle elements manifested as animals, plants, birds, snakes, devatās, demons, humans and total universal form composed of mahat-tattva and other elements. O Supreme! But I did not know what was superior to that material form, and did not know the form of Brahman in which sound does not exist. (SB 4.9.13)**

### Text 33

*yo 'nugrahārthaṁ bhajatāṁ pāda-mūlam*  
*anāma-rūpo bhagavān anantaḥ*  
*nāmāni rūpāṇi ca janma-karmabhir*  
*bheje sa mahyaṁ paramaḥ prasīdatu*

**Перевод:**

**May the unlimited Supreme Lord who, without material name and form, manifests names and forms by his birth and activities in this world to show mercy to those who worship his lotus feet, be pleased with me!**

**Комментарий:**

**Bhagavat Sandarbha 52:**
